title: The specified normalized completed inverse image along an immersion
statement: For an immersion i:S→X [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-open-immersion], a commutative ring A, an ideal I and an actual completed-coefficient complex K [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data], define sfbImmersionAlgebra as the algebraic lift, characterized on generalized sections and constants, of the transported geometric inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Define sfbImmersionCompletedModel to be completedPull [lem-sfb-adic-stratum-completion-unit] of SfbCompletionNormalization.object X I K [lem-sfb-completion-normalization]. This construction takes no completeness or residue witness and makes no arbitrary selection of a perfect or local model.

proof.text: Use the algebraic lift of the transported geometric inverse image, characterized on generalized sections and constants, and apply completedPull to the explicit normalized object. This defines the candidate needed by the parent, independently of completeness and residue witnesses.
